sources.title: What is new with Artificial Intelligence? Human-agent interactions through the lens of social agency

sources.title: A Systematic Literature Review on Explainability for Machine/Deep Learning-based Software Engineering Research
sources.summary: The remarkable achievements of Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms, particularly in Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL), have fueled their extensive deployment across multiple sectors, including Software Engineering (SE). However, due to their black-box nature, these promising AI-driven SE models are still far from being deployed in practice. This lack of explainability poses unwanted risks for their applications in critical tasks, such as vulnerability detection, where decision-making transparency is of paramount importance.
